steps.run: mkdir -p .github/logs; AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); IS_READONLY=false; case "$AGENT" in EmreKilic|AyseDemir|ElifOzgeMaksutoglu|CananBirsen|VarolMaksutoglu) IS_READONLY=true;; esac; if [ "$IS_READONLY" = "true" ]; then echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED-TERMINAL] READ-ONLY agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo "⛔ WARNING: Read-only/coordinator agent attempted terminal access. This is logged."; else echo "[SAFETY-TERMINAL] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi

mkdir -p .github/logs; AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); IS_READONLY=false; case "$AGENT" in EmreKilic|AyseDemir|ElifOzgeMaksutoglu|CananBirsen|VarolMaksutoglu) IS_READONLY=true;; esac; if [ "$IS_READONLY" = "true" ]; then echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED] READ-ONLY agent=$SAFE attempted edit at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo "⛔ WARNING: Read-only agent (T2.5/T3/Orchestrator) attempted a file edit. This action is logged."; else echo "[SAFETY-EDIT] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi

mkdir -p .github/logs; SAFE=$(echo "${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); echo "[SAFETY-TERMINAL-DONE] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log
